args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Use splitFields instead of split(",") when parsing the header row in parseStatement, so that double-quoted column names are properly parsed and do not retain their surrounding quotes.
args.title: Fix header parsing for quoted column names

args.message: Use splitFields for header row parsing to handle quoted column names

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Statements with quoted column names failed because the header was split with split(",") rather than splitFields, leaving quotes attached to header names and causing shape mismatch errors.
